title: Mutable default argument keeps state between calls: default to None

problem.description: Default values are evaluated once. A list default is shared by every call.

files.check.py:
from bag import add

assert add(1) == [1]
assert add(2) == [2]
shared = [0]
assert add(3, shared) == [0, 3]

limitations.proves: Each call without a bucket starts empty; passing a list still appends to it.
limitations.does_not_prove: Anything about other mutable defaults (dicts, sets) elsewhere in the code.
